about_short_description.short_description: Conta Simples provides a solution that combines expense management software, corporate cards, and checking account for Latam SMBs.

product.name: Corporate Credit Cards
product.description: A service to issue multiple corporate credit cards with flexible or approved credit limits for business expenses management.

product.name: Expense Management Platform
product.description: A platform to organize, categorize, and control company expenses with real-time tracking and automated categorization by cost centers and users.

product.name: Credit Solutions
product.description: Financial credit services including approved credit lines, pay-later options, and receivables anticipation to support business payment flexibility.

product.name: Banking Services
product.description: Services for making Pix transfers, issuing and paying boletos, and processing batch payments within a single platform.

product.name: Conta Global (Global Account)
product.description: A global business account enabling international purchases, multi-currency cards, and foreign currency transfers without IOF tax.
